task.title: Relics: the board's task API lists a task's relic links
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M29). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`GET /api/tasks/<id>` on `workbook serve` does not list the relics linked to the task, although `workbook show <task>` does. The reference documents this gap.

## Wanted

Add the linked relics to the task response, in the shape `workbook show --json` uses.

## Done when

- The task response lists linked relics and parts.
- The reference no longer lists this as a gap.

## Notes

Do this with "Relics: add relics to the web board".
